properties.name: Rover Position 1
properties.description: Rover footprint at heading 0° (north). Uses shared base path - all features display the same image. Click to view image.

properties.name: Rover Position 2
properties.description: Rover footprint at heading 45° (northeast). Image rotates based on heading property using angleProp.

properties.name: Rover Position 3
properties.description: Rover footprint at heading 90° (east). Demonstrates show='click' behavior - click marker to display image.

properties.name: Rover Position 4
properties.description: Rover footprint at heading 270° (west). All features share the same base image URL but with different rotations.
